base: 3a1bdfe2, merged with staging 5ee060be in 42a1895c and a809ac35 in 1b95f3e2 (no rebase)

built.D1: A matched candidate accepted by a stored evidence confirmation becomes a citation on the building's record through the registry correction path (draft, amendment, review, commit). A table row is cited by registry-table-evidence.ts; a document part keeps the native citation with its exact quote (registry-document-evidence.ts). No cell or part value becomes a field. Accepting a several, conflicting or no_match candidate is refused 409 INTAKE_EVIDENCE_NOT_MATCHED, in words.
built.D2: Only a stored confirmation is written. Every pin (profile, source revision, SHA-256 and bytes, reading, package revision and review, candidate hash and evidence) is checked again before the draft and again in the commit transaction; a moved pin refuses 409 INTAKE_EVIDENCE_STALE. One operations receipt per confirmation and building is stored in the commit transaction, so a replay writes nothing.
built.D3: The E1 run has an evidence step between record and snapshot. It writes revision n+1 and stores the evidence artefact; the snapshot pins the cited revision. A building with no confirmation goes on as before. registryWritten is true once every accepted building holds its receipt.
built.D4: The plan accepts 'CSV logical row N' and an evidence citation's pointer; it reads the original again and refuses an excerpt that is not byte-exact. The card quotes each citation exactly from the stored citation, with the file name, the locator in words and 'Evidence confirmed by the officer by an exact key; it states no right or owner.'
built.D5: A confirmation stored after its building is carded queues an evidence-phase run job for that building only. The job writes the citations as record revision n+1 through the same writer (one receipt per confirmation and building), drops the carried artefacts (snapshot, plan, plan confirmation, packet, card, verification) from the target, then carries the building again through the existing run steps to a new snapshot and a new card under the evidence confirmation. The earlier card row is never edited. A confirmation stored while its building was being carried is written when that carry ends. A replay writes nothing.
built.windowed: A streamed CSV row is read again from its own byte range only (length and SHA-256 against window.sha256, the stored usp_table_windows row's fence, window hash and bounds, then the stream reader to the hashed cells). A streamed workbook row (window.sheet present, XW1) proves its sheet's stored ZIP bytes unchanged by range reads of at most 1 MiB, hashed and never kept, once per source and sheet range in one write or check call; its cells come from the stored window read back by readTableWindowTx, matched by record and physical row, and must hash to the candidate's rowSha256. No sheet XML is parsed again. The excerpt starts with 'Sheet <name>, row <physical row>'; a marked cell is shown as 'header: unknown' and is never a key. Range reads take the deadline rule of a streamed table's read (streamingReadMs of the range length). A large original is never read whole.

noRuntime: No Docker, database, provider or GPU. Backend tests use mocked clients and the real NYC files. amendConfirmedEvidenceTx and the document-part path are covered by typecheck and the shared citation checks, not by a database run.
gaps: The late card is a separate card (new card id, revision 1), not revision 2 of the first card: card-service.ts refuses a revision whose plan or snapshot differs (CARD_REVISION_CONTEXT), and that file is outside this task's paths. The first card stays stored unchanged; the target's card artefact names the new card.
intake-run.ts (additive evidence phase), intake-evidence.ts and intake-evidence-citations.ts are touched outside the listed owned files.
A crash between the late plan and its confirmation can leave an unconfirmed plan behind; the resumed job makes the plan again under the same request key.
The plan charges a cited sheet's stored bytes to its 64 MiB read bound once per sheet range; a cited sheet whose stored bytes exceed that bound is refused PACKET_PLAN_SOURCE_LIMIT.
